svg.title: Azure AI Foundry: Hub vs Project
svg.desc: The Azure AI Foundry Hub contains the Hub itself, the shared governance layer, which provides four shared resources: Key Vault for shared secrets, Storage Account for shared artifacts, Container Registry for shared images, and App Insights for shared monitoring. The Hub serves several projects, for example Project: HR Agent, Project: Finance Agent and Project: Customer Support.
svg.text: Azure AI Foundry: Hub vs Project
Hub = shared platform and governance. Project = individual AI application or team workspace.
